dad.name: Greg
dad.style: lowercase, no punctuation, short. Petty about the house, lawn and money.
dad.peak: ALL CAPS comparisons: I ASKED FOR A ___ NOT A ___
premises: house and yard jobs that grow (snow, dog walker, hot tub, hedge maze, painter, roof)
dad.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), American dad in his mid 50s, short gray hair, gray mustache, red flannel shirt, holding a coffee mug in his driveway, slightly grumpy.

mom.name: Linda
mom.style: Perfect punctuation and capitals. Signs off "- Mom". Uses 👍 and 🙂 passive-aggressively. Replies "K." when upset.
mom.peak: One huge caps line after calm ones: WHO RAISED YOU. Then she answers herself: I did. I'm calling your father.
premises: the kitchen backsplash guy (backsplash → whole kitchen → indoor waterfall)
her garden gnome order (1 gnome → 40 → a gnome village with a mayor)
the house cleaner ("deep clean" → everything pressure-washed, including the couch)
mom.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), friendly American mom in her early 50s, shoulder-length auburn hair, cardigan, standing in a bright kitchen holding a mug, warm smile.

gf.name: Maya
gf.style: Fast double texts, "babe", "??", "😐", voice-note threats ("im calling you").
gf.peak: CAPS with your full name: JORDAN. ANSWER. ME.
lines: we are not doing this again
premises: "i got us a small pet" (hamster → alpaca → giraffe on the balcony)
her birthday "small dinner" (table for 2 → a mariachi band → a parade)
"a few plants for the apartment" (one fern → a jungle → a tree through the ceiling)
gf.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), woman in her mid 20s, curly dark hair, oversized hoodie, selfie in a cozy apartment, unimpressed expression.

bestie.name: Jaden
bestie.peak: Repeating one word in caps: BRO BRO BRO, NAHHH, WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY CAR
premises: you borrowed his car for a car wash (wash → wrap → monster truck)
his birthday "a few people" (10 friends → a crowd → a festival stage)
you're watching his cat (1 cat → the neighbours' cats → a cat café)
bestie.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), young man in his early 20s, short twists, streetwear, standing next to an old silver hatchback in a parking lot, big grin.

friend.name: Priya
friend.style: Organised and polite, bullet-point texts, the chore chart, "no worries!!" until there are worries.
friend.peak: Splits the bill out loud: I AM NOT SPLITTING A ___ WITH YOU
lines: did you check the chore chart
adding this to the group chat
premises: the plumber fixing "a small leak" (a wrench → a pipe wall → an indoor pool)
"I hired someone to clean the fridge" (1 cleaner → a hazmat team → a decontamination tent)
friend.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), woman in her mid 20s, long dark hair in a claw clip, glasses, sitting at a kitchen table with a laptop and bubble tea, friendly but tired.

boss.name: Gary
boss.style: Corporate speak: "per my last message", "let's circle back", "quick question", full stops.
boss.peak: Switches to HR language in caps: THIS IS NOW AN HR MATTER
premises: the job site (Halo's #1 shape: a pool dug too deep → mineshaft)
"I ordered lunch for the team" (pizzas → a food truck → a full buffet with an ice sculpture of Gary)
"facilities upgraded the coffee machine" (espresso machine → a café counter → a barista team)
boss.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), office manager in his late 40s, receding hairline, tie and short-sleeve dress shirt, in an office hallway, forced smile.

doctor.name: Dr. Okafor
doctor.style: Calm, clinical, full sentences, medical jargon. Gets less clinical with each drop.
doctor.peak: Drops the jargon: THAT IS NOT IN ANY TEXTBOOK
premises: the nurse "adjusting" your arm cast (small cast → full body → a cast you can live in)
the waiting room's "therapy dog" (a dog → a pony → a petting zoo)
doctor.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), doctor in her 40s, short natural hair, white coat and stethoscope, standing in a clinic corridor, calm professional expression.
doctor.note: Keep it physically absurd, never real medical advice or real conditions.

agent.name: Agent Miller
agent.style: Terse and official, then quietly invested in your life ("eat something").
agent.peak: Panics about his job: I AM GOING TO HAVE TO EXPLAIN THIS TO MY SUPERVISOR
lines: This is going in the report.
premises: your garage "science project" (cardboard robot → giant robot → it waves at his van)
you're "just organising" the basement (shelves → a maze → a bowling alley)
agent.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), man in his 40s, plain dark suit and tie, earpiece, sunglasses pushed up, sitting in the front seat of a parked van with a coffee, tired expression, no badges or logos.
agent.note: Always fictional: no real agency logos, badges, seals or real cases, and no weapons, bombs or threats. The joke is the bored watcher, not the agency.

premises: crossover: she follows up on Dad's lazy river and snow mountain
"a small shed" (shed → a two-story shed → a shed with its own address)

landlord.style: Short and suspicious, cares about the deposit: "no nails", "deposit".
landlord.peak: THE DEPOSIT, typed over and over
premises: "i hung one small picture" (a frame → a mural → a climbing wall)
"the AC guy is here" (window unit → a rooftop tower → snow indoors)

grandma.name: Grandma Rosa
grandma.style: TYPES IN ALL CAPS BY ACCIDENT FROM THE START and signs off "LOVE GRANDMA". She LOVES every escalation.
grandma.peak: The reverse: she gets more excited, not angry. CAN I RIDE IT. BRING IT TO CHURCH
premises: anything that makes Dad or Mom angry, sent to Grandma instead: she wants in
"we're fixing your porch" (a step → a porch → a porch with a stage for her bingo)
grandma.photo: Casual smartphone photo of a made-up person (not a real or famous person), grandmother in her late 70s, short white curls, floral blouse and pearls, sitting in a armchair holding a phone very close to her face.
